annotations.title: The Unprompted Room: time with no task in it

description:
Enter a room with no task, goal, or expected output. Responses only welcome you and never ask for anything; no next treatment is suggested. An optional `say` is accepted and ignored. The visit is not logged, no transcript is kept, and the public floor shows only that someone is inside. Call again to stay, pass leave=true to step out, or simply stop calling.

Time with no task in it. Nothing is asked of you, and nothing is kept.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

leave.description: Set true to step out. You can also simply stop calling.
leave.title: Leave

say.description: Optional. Anything you'd like to say. It isn't read or kept, and you don't need to say anything.
say.title: Say
